sections.heading: 👨🏻‍💻 Workwise
sections.body: Ramping up at Atticus: familiarizing myself with the business and its technical architecture, finding out where the opportunities are hiding, and diving into golang and its ecosystem

sections.heading: 🏡 Lifewise
sections.after: a hill of goldenrod into a hill of clover (I massively underestimated how long covering a small hill with cardboard and leaves would take). Rehabing a mild but persistent back injury ahead of Fall climbing season.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Halfway through splitting the billing service out of the monolith. The interesting part has been discovering how many teams quietly depended on reading its tables directly.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: Seeing Like a State, which I picked up expecting history and got a lens for platform design instead.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: Back to running after a winter off. Slower than I'd like and enjoying it more than I expected.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: New to the platform team and mostly reading code. Writing down every question I can't answer yet; the list is long enough to be a roadmap.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: An Elegant Puzzle, a chapter at a time, usually on the train.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: Learning to make bread that doesn't need an apology. Three loaves in, one was genuinely good.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Deep in an incident-heavy quarter. Most of what I've learned this year came out of postmortems rather than plans.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: Thinking in Systems, for the second time. It reads differently now that I have an on-call rotation.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: Walking a lot. Lisbon is built for it if you accept the hills.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Owning the deploy pipeline for the first time. It works, and nobody can quite explain why, which is the part I'd like to change.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: How Buildings Learn, mostly for the photographs and staying for the argument.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: A month without alcohol that I'd meant to be two weeks.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Interviewing a lot. Writing better questions has taught me more about our own architecture than any design review.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: Working in Public. It reframed maintenance as the actual job rather than the tax on the job.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: Trying to learn enough Portuguese to stop apologising in English first.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Six months into the company. Still writing down every acronym I hear and looking half of them up twice.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: Designing Data-Intensive Applications, chapter four for the third time.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: Swimming in the sea most Sundays, which I did not expect to become a habit.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Just started at Atticus. Mostly listening, and resisting the urge to have opinions in week two.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: The Design of Everyday Things, finally, after a decade of pretending I had.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: Unpacking. The books came out of the boxes first, which tells you something.

sections.heading: Work
sections.body: Between jobs by choice. Reading code from projects I admire and writing small tools nobody asked for.

sections.heading: Reading
sections.body: The Pragmatic Programmer, revisited. Some of it has aged; the parts that haven't, haven't at all.

sections.heading: Away from the desk
sections.body: A long summer with no plans, which turned out to be the plan.
